top_stories.title: 【リリース】claude-code v2.1.325: v2.1.325
top_stories.body:
## What's changed

- Fixed a security issue in how zstd-compressed responses are decoded
- Added a spinner tip in VS Code and similar integrated terminals about re-running a notebook cell, shown once Claude has read or edited a Jupyter notebook
- Added a line under the error shown when your organization's policy blocks a request, saying how to continue: run `/rewind` and change the message, or run `/clear`
- Added a note for Claude when a sandboxed `git checkout`, `git stash` or autostash pull cannot update protected files such as those in `.claude`
- Fixed `/security-review` and skills' inlin

top_stories.title: 【リリース】claude-code v2.1.323: v2.1.323
top_stories.body:
## What's changed

- Added Code Mode, an experimental opt-in in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its tools; see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode to turn it on, or to turn it off for an organization
- Added `engines["claude-code"]` to `plugin.json`: plugins outside their stated Claude Code version range are not installed, updated or loaded, and install and update pick the newest version that fits
- Added type checking of a plugin's TypeScript hooks module to `claude plugin validate`; each finding is a warning, and `--strict` fails on it
- Added to `claude plugin validate` the `$`

top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-typescript sdk-v1.8.0: sdk-v1.8.0
top_stories.body:
### Features

* **api:** add Claude Tag metrics to the analytics summaries and users reports
* **api:** add reply_mode to Claude Tag Slack channel settings


### Chores

* **docs:** clarify display_name for RBAC Roles created by Anthropic
* **docs:** clarify plugin delete and skill name conflict descriptions
* **docs:** clarify when to omit user_profile_id on external keys
* **docs:** note that Claude Tag settings accept self-hosted runner pools


### Documentation

* **examples:** show multiagent when creating a Managed Agents agent

top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-python v2.8.0: v2.8.0
top_stories.body:
### Features

* **api:** add Claude Tag metrics to the analytics summaries and users reports
* **api:** add reply_mode to Claude Tag Slack channel settings


### Bug Fixes

* **bedrock:** send ";" in a model ID as is, and refuse a model ID whose part before the first ";" is empty, "." or ".."
* **google-cloud:** percent-encode the project, location and workspace ID in the workspace and organization base URL paths
* **google-cloud:** refuse an empty project, location or workspace ID that would be written into a derived base URL
* **vertex:** refuse an empty model, project ID or region instead o
